summary: Design governed bot handoffs, sentiment reviews and knowledge workflows across service channels. Explore the five-day course and outline.
lede: AI-assisted customer service operations helps service leaders shape governed workflows across email, chat and contact centre channels. It is for customer service managers, contact centre supervisors, CX leads and operations teams coordinating automated support with human judgment. Learners map service journeys and bot-to-agent handoffs, interpret sentiment, structure knowledge articles, and develop quality scorecards and service governance controls using ISO 18295-1, KCS practices and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals responsible for customer-facing service workflows, agent decisions or service governance across digital and contact centre channels.
modules: NIST AI RMF for Service Workflows
prerequisites: Working familiarity with customer service operations in at least one channel is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
